name: Thrift Store Boy
summary: Earn coins by selling mushrooms and potions, then splurge at the thrift store to decorate your house and unlock thrilling mini games. With a convenient save-game feature, you can seamlessly pick up where you left off. Immerse yourself in the enchanting island, inhabited by diverse villagers who engage in captivating conversations. Discover hidden gems as you explore and delight in interacting with the villagers and indulging in the plethora of side games this extraordinary adventure has to offer.
